@Taffer@mastodon.gamedev.place If you end up giving this a go, I'll happily boost your posts once in a while to help you get a little bit of extra exposure.

That being said: why not go for a more interesting type of AI? Something with actual explicit knowledge and actual logical reasoning? Something based on RDF and SPARQL? Save the neural networks for the only thing they're really good at (recognition tasks)?

Some examples of work that is much more interesting and profound than what the big tech companies are doing:

https://sepidehalassi.github.io/textToRDFGraph/
https://github.com/kovvalsky/LangPro

#AI #AIResearch #profoundAI #fairAI
